decisions.reason: s0065 ends with 開府儀同三司, the privilege of opening a headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Dukes; "Grand Mausoleum" invents a mausoleum sense absent from the Chinese, and the proposed idiomatic rendering restores the honorific accurately.

The same s0065 phrase 開府儀同三司 means opening an office with ceremony equal to the Three Dukes, not a "Grand Mausoleum"; the bracketed literal clarifies the granted right without changing the other titles.
s0067 has 及太清中; 太清 is the Liang era Taiqing, whereas Taiping would be 太平, so the proposed romanization corrects a real reign-name error.
Literal field for s0067 likewise misreads 太清 as Taiping; Taiqing matches the Chinese era name and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
s0076 opens 太清五年夏四月; again 太清 is Taiqing, not Taiping, and the rest of the proposed sentence matches the Chinese march narrative.
The literal for s0076 repeats the same 太清五年 era error; Taiqing is the correct romanization and no other meaning is altered.
s0149 has 復太清之號; Taqing drops the medial i of Taiqing and is not a valid reading of 太清, so the proposed fix is a necessary romanization correction.
Literal s0149 likewise restores the era name from Taqing to Taiqing for 太清, matching the Chinese without other changes.
s0185 begins 太清之寇; Taqing is a misspelling of Taiqing for 太清, and the proposed idiomatic line otherwise preserves the historian's judgment.
The literal appraisal likewise requires Taiqing for 太清之寇; Taqing is unsupported, and the replacement is otherwise faithful.
